reviews.comment:
I left my cat here for almost a week and had a good experience thus far!! It was my first time leaving my cat with someone other than a close friend so I was pretty worried especially since most boarding options don’t have too much information on cats. Additionally the meet and greet option helps give you a peace of mind when going to check out where your pet is going to be while you’re away. The owners are super kind and took good care of my cat Stevie while I was on my trip and accommodated to my cats needs. I received daily updates with videos , even though my cat wasn’t too thrilled to be away from home lol.
Overall my cat is in good health and all of his belongings are doing good as well. This is a place that earned my trust and I know I can come back to it on my next trip if I ever need to. Thanks again to the owners and I recommend this place for sure
